agent_notes: Both supplied NIRF 2025 Engineering and Overall participated-institute listings contain the exact institution name with city Indore and state Madhya Pradesh.
The official About page identifies a 501-acre residential campus at Simrol near Indore, Madhya Pradesh; the official footer gives Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore 453552.

The official academic-programme catalogue lists current active undergraduate, postgraduate, dual-degree, MS(Research), doctoral and M.A. programmes with academic-year entries. No active diploma or certificate programme is listed there.

The official high-level academics page additionally displays the programme-family labels M.Tech. + PhD, M.Sc + PhD and MS + Ph.D; these are retained as verified programme-family pathways, while the detailed academic-programme catalogue enumerates the discipline-specific offerings.
Duration was populated only where an official catalogue page explicitly states it; eligibility and unstated durations remain null.
